_comment: Golden IO contract for LFM2.5-2.6B-ONNX (Lfm2ForCausalLM), discovered empirically by the live probe (tests/live/llm_live.rs). Single source of truth for the M1 decoder's LlmIo defaults. Prefill uses input_ids/attention_mask/position_ids plus zero past_conv and empty past_key_values; each decode step feeds the present_* outputs back as past_* inputs.
